model: neighbour-rule CA: vacant cells take the uses their 8 neighbours support, until demand is met

parameters.growth: each class's growth spread evenly over the steps, best-supported cells first, random tie-break

caveat: Demand is set by us, not derived from a regional model. This explores the consequences of a development programme, it does not forecast one.
_programmes_note: The entries under 'scenarios' are land-use programmes (baseline, compact, green) over the whole buurt. They are NOT the Rhino design options scenario_a and scenario_b; those are scored on the same objective in landuse_scenarios.json.

baseline.label: reference: no development programme. Demand equals the current counts so nothing converts — this is the comparison state, NOT a validation of the model.

compact.label: compact: maximum housing plus mixed ground floors

green.label: green: less housing, more park and amenity

validation._note: Erase a random share of developed cells, restore the original demand, and measure how much of the original map the CA reproduces. Kappa discounts chance agreement from guessing the commonest class.
